title: The Vault of Shadows
start: Talk to Dr Nabanik outside the Kharid-et Dig Site.

requirements.t:
Time Served or
 An ancient timepiece to complete Time Served

All eight shadow anchors powered or
 Under the effect of Protection of Zaros (only required for one step)

items.t: Ancient timepiece (if Time Served is not completed)
Pontifex signet ring (can be on the tool belt)
500 Divination memories, vibrant or better (collected after shadow engrammeter (depleted) has been obtained)

recommended.t: Ring of visibility or Sliske's gift (post-mystery completion for extra rewards)
'Animate Dead' spell scroll (alternatively players can use an 'Animate Dead' spell scroll (loaned) given by Dr Nabanik)
'Exsanguinate' spell scroll (alternatively players can use an 'Exsanguinate' spell scroll (loaned) given by Dr Nabanik)
'Incite Fear' spell scroll (alternatively players can use an 'Incite Fear' spell scroll (loaned) given by Dr Nabanik)
'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll (alternatively players can use a 'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll (loaned) given by Dr Nabanik)

steps.t: Talk to Dr Nabanik near the bank chest at Kharid-et Dig Site. He will "loan" you any of the spell scrolls that you are unable to obtain. [Chat: Accept]
Head into the prison block section of the dig site.
Enter the eastern door which leads to the solitary confinement area.

sub.t: If you haven't completed Time Served but you have the repaired artefact in your inventory, then just inspect the ancient mechanism to the North. Insert the artefact and then the eastern door will open.

steps.t: Go down to the southern end of the corridor, there will be an inactive dial on the west wall, just before the last empty room.
Cast an 'Incite Fear' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the ice button and enter the vault [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Pick up the praetor's log page 1 and right click Transcribe.
NE, E, NE', SW', S, S
SE, SE, C, N'
S', W, NW
Head to the Main Fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site (first room) and go to the south-east corner (the chapel).
Pass the Pontifex barrier and find the inactive dial on the northern wall, directly north of the Orcus altar.
Cast a 'Exsanguinate' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the Blood button and enter the vault [Chat: 1 Yes.]
SW', C, NW, NW, SW'
C', C', NE, SE, C'
NE', NE', C', C', NE'
C', SW', SE, C, SE
C, SE, SW, C, SW'
C, C
Return to the main fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site and go directly north of the Pontifex barrier, by the oven.
Find the inactive dial on the wall immediately west of the oven.
Cast a 'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the smoke button and enter the vault [Chat: 1 Yes.]
5', 2, 7', 3, 3, 4' - Top row complete (all pink)
3, 3, 8, 3, 3 - Second row complete (all red)
7', 4, 8, 4' - Puzzle complete
Return to the Main Fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site and enter the war room by clicking the praetorium war table (middle of the Main Fortress)
Find the inactive dial on the western wall in the small western room.
Cast an 'Animate Dead' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the Shadow button and enter the vault [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Pick up the shadow engrammeter (depleted) from the centre of the vault.
Collect 500 divination memories (vibrant tier or higher). Recharge the Shadow engrammeter when you have an inventory full of memories to charge it. Enriched memories count as double.
Return to the centre of the vault via any of the dials and Operate the engrammeter.
Take Trindine's memory to Dr Nabanik. [Chat: 3 I want to talk about mysteries. › # The Vault of Shadows.]

sub.t: You will receive the memory as a book, and be granted 25,000 Divination experience.

steps.t: Return to the vault using any of the dials.
Speak to Praetor Trindine in the centre. This will complete The Vault of Shadows mystery.

sub.t: If the shadow anchors weren't activated, or Pylon isn't active, you will need to wear a ring of visibility or have the ability to permanently see the Shadow Realm.

steps.t: Return to and speak to Dr Nabanik.
Speak to him again after the cutscene.
